cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && cat index.d.ts; rg -n "SupportedLocales" YagrCore/types.d.ts YagrCore/locale.d.ts | head -4; head -30 YagrCore/locale.js | rg -n "ru|en"; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/src/vite-env.d.ts; rg -n "classList|'yagr'|yagr " YagrCore/index.js | head; rg -n "class .*Card|export.*Card" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,12p Card/Card.d.ts; rg -n "view\??:|size\??:" Button/Button.d.ts | head; rg -n "color\??:" Text/Text.d.ts Text/*.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "justifyContent|alignItems|gap" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -5
